app.title: Tarot Daily
app.footer: UI shell for the Tarot Daily MVP, aligned with the phase-2 design system.

auth.loginCopy: Sign in to restore your profile, preferences, and daily tarot flow.
auth.registerCopy: Set up your seeker profile, timezone, and daily reset rules before your first reading.
auth.timezoneHint: Card of the Day resets at 3:00 AM in your local timezone.

validation.username: Username must be 3-20 characters and alphanumeric.
validation.password: Password must be at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.

dashboard.copy: This dashboard is the phase-2 shell for daily readings, spreads, and future history modules.
dashboard.heroCopy: Theme, language, auth flow, and protected routing are connected. Reading generation will be added in the next phase.
dashboard.loadingCopy: We are loading your profile and shell state.
dashboard.loadingSecondaryCopy: Placeholders are being assembled for the next tarot features.
dashboard.cardCopy: This area will show the deterministic daily reading once phase 3 is connected.
dashboard.cardEmptyCopy: Your daily card will appear here after the reading feature is wired to backend generation.
dashboard.spreadCopy: Role-based spread limits and spread generation will arrive in the next implementation phase.
dashboard.spreadEmptyCopy: This slot is reserved for the three-card spread experience and its empty/loading states.

profile.title: Profile
profile.copy: Your role, timezone, theme, and language are already part of the shared application shell.
profile.accountCopy: Username and timezone are synced with the backend profile endpoint.
profile.preferencesCopy: Language and theme are saved through the settings endpoint and reflected in the shell.
profile.emailReadonly: Email is read-only in the MVP profile flow.
profile.roleReadonly: Role is assigned by platform policy and cannot be edited here.

history.title: History
history.copy: History UI is scaffolded now and will be connected to real reading data in the next phase.
history.emptyCopy: Once tarot generation is connected, your retained readings will appear here according to your role policy.

admin.title: Admin
admin.copy: Admin pages are route-protected in phase 2 and will gain business functionality in later phases.
admin.usersCopy: Reserved for role, status, and moderation workflows.
admin.decksCopy: Reserved for deck uploads, card assets, and card-back controls.
admin.policiesCopy: Reserved for seeker, adept, master, and keeper limits.
admin.settingsCopy: Reserved for maintenance mode, default role, and registration toggles.
admin.placeholder: Protected placeholder page for future admin business logic.
